story.title: Run, walk, and bring cans for Jackson County families.
paragraphs: The Turkey Can Run benefits the FBC Jefferson Food Bank, which serves hundreds of Jackson County families in need every year. Participants are asked to pair the entry fee with canned food items such as tuna, chicken, green beans, corn, peas, jelly, peanut butter, and other non-perishable foods.

runner_decision_checklist.headline: What runners need before Thanksgiving morning in Jefferson.
runner_decision_checklist.intro: A concise checklist for registration, packet pickup, parking, food-bank donations, and the certified 5K course.

items.label: Event format
items.detail: The event is a 5K run/walk through historic downtown Jefferson.

items.label: Race start
items.detail: The 5K starts at 8:00 AM on Thanksgiving morning.

items.label: Entry + food donation
items.detail: Participants pair the entry fee with canned food items for the FBC Jefferson Food Bank.

items.label: Packet pickup
items.value: Advance pickup or 7:00 AM race day
items.detail: Advance pickup is offered Monday through Wednesday at the fellowship hall; race-day pickup starts in the Education Building.

items.label: Race-day parking
items.detail: FBC notes that church-lot parking is not available; participants may park at Jefferson High School with no shuttle service.

items.label: Certified course
items.detail: The course is USA Track & Field certified and qualifies as an AJC Peachtree Road Race qualifier.

faqs.question: Is race-day registration available?
faqs.answer: No. The event page states that race-day registration is not available.

faqs.question: Where do the canned goods go?
faqs.answer: The canned food donations support the FBC Jefferson Food Bank and families in Jackson County.
